title: Epistola Inter Augustianas CCXXVI
author: Prosperus Aquitanus

passages.original: Et hoc non solum aliorum catholicorum testimoniis, sed etiam Sanctitatis tuæ disputatione antiquiore sc probare testantur; ubi tamen eamdem gratiam non minore veritatis perspicuitate docueris : ut est illud quod dixit Sanctitas tua in quæstione contra Porphyrium, de tempore christianae religionis, i tunc voluisse hominibus apparere Christum, et apud eos prædicari doctrinam suam, quando sciebat et ubi sciebat esse, qui in cum fuerant credituri » (Epist. 102, qucest.
passages.english: And they declare that they prove this not only by the testimonies of other catholics, but also by an earlier discussion of Your Holiness, in which, however, you taught that same grace with no less clarity of truth: such as what Your Holiness said in the question against Porphyry concerning the time of the Christian religion, that "Christ willed to appear to men and to have his teaching preached among them at the time when and in the place where he knew there were those who were going to believe in him" (Letter 102, question
passages.notes: Scanning errors corrected: 'sc' read as 'se', 'i tunc' as '« tunc' (opening quotation mark), 'cum' as 'eum', 'qucest.' as 'quæst.'. The reference is cut off at the end of the passage and continues in the following text ('2, n. 14').
